title: Annual Sports Meet & Athletic Championship Concluded with Grandeur

Proud moment for Indian Public School  Heartiest Congratulations to Shivaay Jain of Grade 3 on securing the Winner’s position in the BS-U9 category at the Yonex-Sunrise Sambalpur District Badminton Championship, held at Burla MPIS from 2nd to 4th October 2026.  Wishing you many more victories and a bright future in badminton!!  Regards Academic Unit
This is to inform the Students of Nursery to 8 that INTER HOUSE DIYA MAKING AND DECORATION COMPETITION will be organised on 6th November 2026 (Friday) during school hours.   Regards Academic Unit.

Regular Classes will remain suspended on 31st October 2026 ( Saturday ) for Grade Nursery to 8 on account of Parent Teacher Meeting for Grade Nursery to 5 scheduled for the day.  TIMING FOR PTM : 9.00 am to 12.00 noon   However, Grade 9 to 12 will have their Classes as per the regular school timings and schedule.  Regards Academic Unit

This is to hereby notify the students of Grade 9 and 11 that the Promotion to next Grade will be done only if a student secures minimum Pass Marks in all the subjects in Half Yearly and Annual Examination along with fulfillment of minimum 75% Attendance as laid down strictly by CBSE Board.  Students are hereby required to prepare well for the upcoming Half Yearly Examination and also be present regularly to school.  Regards  Academic Unit
